results.title: Notion Launches Notion Mail — a Reimagined Email Client Built on Its Block Editor
results.description: Notion today launched Notion Mail, a full email client built on its block-based editor, allowing users to draft, organize, and automate email within their workspace. The product enters public beta immediately.

results.title: Notion Raises Series D at $15B Valuation, Eyes Enterprise Expansion
results.description: Productivity platform Notion has closed a $350M Series D round at a $15B valuation, led by Sequoia Capital. CEO Ivan Zhao said funds will accelerate enterprise features including advanced permissions, audit logs, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

results.title: Notion Expands AI Features with Notion Q&A for Enterprise Knowledge Management
results.description: Notion launched Q&A, an AI-powered knowledge search across all workspace documents, databases, and integrations. Enterprise customers can query across thousands of pages in natural language with cited sources.
